significance: A Venkateswara temple at Srinivasamangapuram near Tirupati, listed by the Archaeological Survey of India as a monument of national importance and administered by the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams since 1981. Newly married couples come here for blessings.
story: Venkateswara is said to have spent the first six months after his marriage to Padmavathi at this place.
